text:
Alex: early heads-up — anyone up for a sunrise gravel ride + coffee run this Saturday? ~40km relaxed pace, leaving Pier 7 6:30am. route: https://ride.example.com/loop. Bring lights & layers. :bike: :coffee:

Maya: ooh yes! count me in. hybrid should be fine, right? i'm slow but steady. :raised_hands:

Ravi: i'd love to — only if we keep the roads low-traffic. also any chance for a shorter option? 20-25km works for me.

Alex: yep — there's a ~25km out-and-back option if folks want shorter. mostly waterfront gravel + park trails. finish at Dockside Roasters for coffee/brunch.

Sophia: would be great but 6:30 is rough for me. i'll join for brunch at Dockside Roasters ~10am if that's ok.

Chris: family thing this Sat so out, sadly. send pics pls :sunglasses: 

weather-bot: Saturday 06:00 — Temp 12°C / 54°F, light breeze, 0-10% rain. Sunrise 6:12. Good riding weather.

Maya: perfect. who wants a ride share? i have one spare spot for a bike in my car.

Jen: if you want, I can create a calendar invite. run: ```
/calendar create "Sunrise gravel + coffee" Saturday 06:30 Pier 7
```

calendar-bot: Event created: "Sunrise gravel + coffee" Sat 06:30 — Invited: Alex, Maya, Ravi, Sophia.

Ravi: thanks! added. can someone drop a quick gear checklist? first-timer for gravel.

Alex: helmet, front/rear lights, tube + mini-pump, tire levers, flat kit, layers, cash/card for coffee. will post a tiny gpx before Sat.

Sophia: will meet you at Dockside at 10 then. have fun you early birds! :coffee:

Chris: obligatory sunrise photo pls (reacts with :camera_with_flash:).
